title: Capability Genesis composes two existing tools, attached capabilities first, before it builds (C.G4)
problem: A founder-signed contract that two installed tools answer together (distinct lines = sort -u | wc -l) still paid for a build, and the uncatalogued route never looked at what the registry already had ATTACHED.
baseline: #256 head 0fe656c6: single installed templates only, then the builder.

alternatives.name: Proposed: two-stage pipelines, attached registry capabilities first, qualified like single tools
alternatives.description: Stage 1 prints text from one file (attached capability or text template); stage 2 is any template. Stage 1 pinned as a companion.
advantages: No new licensing or restore machinery: companions are already checked
disadvantages: Search cost grows with stage-1 x stage-2 pairs

alternatives.name: Arbitrary-depth shell pipelines
alternatives.revival_evidence: A recurring deficit that needs three stages

alternatives.name: Compose any ATTACHED capabilities through their adapters
disadvantages: Needs typed adapter contracts between capability outputs and inputs
alternatives.revival_evidence: Typed output-to-input contracts exist for two attached capabilities

alternatives.name: Let the builder write the composition
disadvantages: Spends the build budget on what existing tools do; generated code instead of pinned binaries

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Every contract two tools could answer pays for a build.
disadvantages: Formed capabilities are never reused by later deficits

roles.position: Composition before build is rung 2 of the resourcefulness ladder.
material_concerns: Do not claim general composition; two binary stages only

roles.position: One more step inside the existing discovery route; stage 1 rides the companion mechanism.
material_concerns: Origin kind 'pipeline' is distinct from recombine's 'composed'

roles.position: Held-out vectors decide; both binaries pinned; a changed stage 1 quarantines at restart.
material_concerns: A pipeline that matches public examples by coincidence

roles.position: Stage-1 outputs computed once per example and shared; failed searches stay memoized by fingerprint including attached sources.
material_concerns: Search time on bodies with many attached capabilities
evidence_refs: composition tests run in about 25 s for 7 tests

roles.position: No authority change; attach under existing rules; each binary's licence is qualified.
material_concerns: Intermediate output is bounded (16 MiB) and refused, not truncated

evidence.claim: text.distinct_line_count served by sort -u | wc -l with no build
evidence.finding: ACHIEVED, builder.calls == [], ATTACHED after restart; all 6 original tests fail on 0fe656c6

evidence.claim: Capability dividend is caused by composition
evidence.finding: with _pipeline_search disabled the same mission calls the builder once
stage 1 is the attached acquired.text.sorted_unique_lines.sort; the record lists fs.read as examined and unusable
4 new mutants caught; 2 existing patterns re-anchored, 0 stale across all groups

counterevidence.finding: it also changes an outcome: text.lines_including_last, which #256 sent to the builder, is now served correctly by sort -- {file} | wc -l; that test was scoped to single tools

pass_1.intended_outcome: Contracts two existing tools answer together are served without a build, reusing attached capabilities first.

advantages.statement: Formed capabilities become building blocks for later deficits
advantages.amplified_value: Each acquisition widens what the next mission can get without a build

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Stage-1 outputs shared; memo by fingerprint
Stated in C.G4 next; builder remains the next rung
Held-out vectors through the serving pipeline decide

comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: typed composition of any attached capabilities

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack: unpinned stage 1, oversized intermediate, stale memo after a new attach, detached pair re-registered.

new_weaknesses.statement: A changed stage-1 binary keeps serving
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Both hashes checked at serve and at restore; restore mutant caught

new_weaknesses.statement: A failed search is never retried after a new capability is attached

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: a recurring deficit composition cannot serve
a recurring deficit composition cannot serve
a recurring deficit composition cannot serve

pass_2.final_design: Two-stage pipelines after single templates, attached registry capabilities first, qualified on public plus held-out vectors through the serving pipeline, both binaries pinned and licence-qualified, restored with both pins.

residual_risks.risk: Search cost on bodies with many attached text capabilities
residual_risks.mitigation: memoized; measured on next real body

migration_plan: None; existing capabilities and routes are unchanged.
kill_criteria: A pipeline attaches while failing any held-out vector
A pipeline keeps serving after either binary changed
A pipeline writes outside its workspace or reaches the network
review_trigger: First real mission served by a pipeline, or a proposal for deeper or typed composition
